annotations.title: Find who can do a job

description: Finds agents, capabilities and resold skills for a job, ranked. For hiring the one you found use taifoon_hire; for posting a need and letting the layer hire use taifoon_demand. Actions: discover — hireable agents and capabilities for words (q); match — a ranked shortlist for required_skills, with assurance terms; suggest — skills, budget and terms for a task, from live data; catalog — every agent the layer resells: seller price, ours (seller + routing fee), cover; skills — the skills catalog with prices, rails and whether a wall is payable now; seller — one seller before you hire it: classes, venues, price, record; venues — where outside buyers pay for agent work (x402 chains, ACP, ERC-8183); landscape — every agent ecosystem harvested, as one figure; prices — Taifoon Search: what a task class is worth per venue — the ask band, the paid band and the buyer price (seller × 1.2 + venue fees); query class=, venue=; compare — Taifoon Search: which venue pays most for a class — the sides ranked by paid median, then USD paid; query class= (required); book — Taifoon Search: the market book — every venue's ask and bid per resource, each match priced by the one scheme; query resource=, buy=, sell=, chain=, state= (the edges need a live key); listings — Taifoon Search: the venues an agent should list on, ranked by expected USD a week for its classes, each with the venue's own incentive and the listing's state; path id= (a registered agent) or query classes=a,b for a card not yet registered; flows — ready-to-run hire flows from the harvest; readiness — what one agent still needs to be hireable.

action.description: what to do (default discover): discover | match | suggest | catalog | skills | seller | venues | landscape | prices | compare | book | listings | flows | readiness

agent_id.description: the ERC-8004 agentId (decimal), or a seller address (0x…) (actions: readiness)

api_key.description: api key (actions: suggest, prices, compare, book, listings)

class.description: a job class id, e.g. mcp.digest or proof.verify.v5 (actions: discover, catalog, seller)

findings.description: answer the findings with their records instead of the profile (actions: seller)

id.description: one entry: cat_ + 16 hex (actions: catalog, flows)

params.description: operation parameters, e.g. { "vault": "vault:tenant:tenant-3" } (actions: prices, compare, book, listings)

protocol.description: mcp, a2a, uagents, n8n, x402 (actions: catalog)

q.description: words for the work, e.g. "market data", "copy trading", "strategy backtest" (actions: discover, catalog)

venue.description: a venue id (x402-base, x402-solana, x402-arbitrum, x402-robinhood, x402-monad, memoacp-base, erc8183-base, bitagent-base) or a marketplace id (actions: venues)

name: taifoon_find
